items.body_excerpt:
Perfect World 

Imagine a world beyond

this one,

Imagine a world with

unexpected fun.

A world so immaculate

clean not one problem.

Poor and richer existed

like no other.

Evaporated with no

levels set,

Clear minded thoughts

not a murder exist yet.

A world so deep no

worries as you sleep.

All creatures so

kind,

All purity in the hearts

and mind,

Fantasy becomes a day to

day reality.

Not a dream

unanswered,

Not a prayer

forgotten,

All thoughts so

real,

Not a single fruit gone

rotten.

A whisper is unheard

of,

All secrets not

kept,

Love and prosperity

comfortably leapt.

A world in such

delight,

Candle lit dinners with

dessert on all minds.

Mud like whipped

cream,

And time is so

pleasurable it seems.

If you take a look and

search deep,

Then you will find this

world I see.

Poem by: Matt James

items.body_excerpt:
Perfect World 

Imagine a world beyond

this one,

Imagine a world with

unexpected fun.

A world so immaculate

clean not one problem.

Poor and richer existed

like no other.

Evaporated with no

levels set,

Clear minded thoughts

not a murder exist yet.

A world so deep no

worries as you sleep.

All creatures so

kind,

All purity in the hearts

and mind,

Fantasy becomes a day to

day reality.

Not a dream

unanswered,

Not a prayer

forgotten,

All thoughts so

real,

Not a single fruit gone

rotten.

A whisper is unheard

of,

All secrets not

kept,

Love and prosperity

comfortably leapt.

A world in such

delight,

Candle lit dinners with

dessert on all minds.

Mud like whipped

cream,

And time is so

pleasurable it seems.

If you take a look and

search deep,

Then you will find this

world I see.

Poem by: Matt James

items.body_excerpt:
Perfect World 

Imagine a world beyond

this one,

Imagine a world with

unexpected fun.

A world so immaculate

clean not one problem.

Poor and richer existed

like no other.

Evaporated with no

levels set,

Clear minded thoughts

not a murder exist yet.

A world so deep no

worries as you sleep.

All creatures so

kind,

All purity in the hearts

and mind,

Fantasy becomes a day to

day reality.

Not a dream

unanswered,

Not a prayer

forgotten,

All thoughts so

real,

Not a single fruit gone

rotten.

A whisper is unheard

of,

All secrets not

kept,

Love and prosperity

comfortably leapt.

A world in such

delight,

Candle lit dinners with

dessert on all minds.

Mud like whipped

cream,

And time is so

pleasurable it seems.

If you take a look and

search deep,

Then you will find this

world I see.

Poem by: Matt James

items.body_excerpt:
Perfect World 

Imagine a world beyond

this one,

Imagine a world with

unexpected fun.

A world so immaculate

clean not one problem.

Poor and richer existed

like no other.

Evaporated with no

levels set,

Clear minded thoughts

not a murder exist yet.

A world so deep no

worries as you sleep.

All creatures so

kind,

All purity in the hearts

and mind,

Fantasy becomes a day to

day reality.

Not a dream

unanswered,

Not a prayer

forgotten,

All thoughts so

real,

Not a single fruit gone

rotten.

A whisper is unheard

of,

All secrets not

kept,

Love and prosperity

comfortably leapt.

A world in such

delight,

Candle lit dinners with

dessert on all minds.

Mud like whipped

cream,

And time is so

pleasurable it seems.

If you take a look and

search deep,

Then you will find this

world I see.

Poem by: Matt James

items.title: The book of the dead
items.summary:
The book of the dead

1/ 🌟 Join me on a remarkable exploration of near-death experiences (NDEs) and the profound encounters with the beyond.
items.body_excerpt:
The book of the dead

1/ 🌟 Join me on a remarkable exploration of near-death experiences (NDEs) and the profound encounters with the beyond. Each NDE is a unique odyssey, transcending the boundaries of life and offering glimpses into the mysteries that lie beyond the veil.

2/ 🌅 The first brush with the transcendent occurred before my conscious memory, when my mother's protective instincts saved me from a potential tragedy. She spun in her pregnancy, evading a fall that could have had fatal consequences. It was an early encounter with fragility.

3/ 👶 Another brush with the threshold of existence happened during my birth. Born as a 13lb baby, my arrival posed immense challenges. An emergency c-section became a lifeline, preserving both my life and my mother's well-being. Nevertheless, I persisted.

4/ 🚗 Att 15, driving illegally without a license or insurance... Speeding through treacherous backwoods roads, a miraculous series of overcorrections averted disaster, leaving us unscathed. It was a lesson in divine protection and the fragility of choice.

5/ 🔮 During a salvia experience, my consciousness slipped away, and I encountered a realm where I fled from perceived demons. It revealed the interconnectedness between the spiritual and material realms. #AlteredPerception #SpiritualRealms

6/ 💤 I died again. Negotiating the realms of heaven and hell, I was offered the chance to continue my journey on Earth, guided by the purpose of doing good. This profound interaction transformed my perspective and instilled a sense of divine purpose within me. #DivineEncounter

7/ 💫 These NDEs, each unique and powerful in their own right, have shown me the threads that connect life, spirit, and the mysteries of the universe. They have taught me the importance of embracing life's fragility, making conscious choices, and seeking the interconnectedness.

8/ 🌿 Each encounter with the transcendent offers valuable insights into the unseen realms and the infinite possibilities that await us beyond the veil. May these stories kindle a sense of wonder and purpose within your own journey. #TranscendentEncounters #InfinitePossibilities

They're about to put the fuzzy socks back on me and shock the shit out of me again. If my chats with god don't go well, god bless. My last thoughts will be I know my message platform and audience now - it's an ordinals mainnet fork called the book of the dead.

Your time is valuable. Where you focus your attention right now is valuable. 

Sometimes the mind can manufacture a scenario which plays out in an experience that feels like you're being pulled off course. But the work is to stay focussed and pay attention to the communication with the body, and developing deeper levels of trust in deciphering and understanding the language. 

Thank you cannabis for your power of attenuation. Minimising the once dominant noise of fear from the mind, and increasing the volume of the somatic frequencies transmitting joy and inner freedom. 

Karen Mojica - Tokin' Women

items.body_excerpt:
Devotion to cannabis is devotion to the body. 

Movement of the body in any form...
cannabis and running
cannabis and yoga
cannabis and dancing 
cannabis and sex

it's a somatic, visceral, feeling experience. 

Quietening the mind and allowing the body to speak our primal, instinctive language that is ancient intelligence. 

Where all the senses are heightened and enhanced, including the sixth sense translated by the mind through pictures, a vision of what is coming into your life. That is the intelligence of the body speaking. 

Inhaling the smoke into the body, expansion of the lungs, flowing through the vagus nerve, exhaling and breathing it out, creating space to hold more, hear more, and trust more. Bringing our sympathetic and parasympathetic state into balance. 

The channels are clearing, the DMT is moving through the body, the hips are moving, stretching and opening as the intelligence comes through with greater clarity. 

Trusting in the body more and more. Little by little, in gradual increments as it becomes a practice. 

Surrendering more into the wisdom of the body. Focussing the mind into receiving as the information is embodied and expressed into the world. 

Creating the new, informed by the old, in the now. 

Thank you cannabis. 

Karen Mojica

items.body_excerpt:
In Genesis, He is the Creator God.

In Exodus, He is your Redeemer.

In Leviticus, He is your sanctification.

In Numbers, He is your guide.

In Deuteronomy, He is your teacher.

In Joshua, He is the mighty conqueror.

In Judges, He gives you victory over your enemies.

In Ruth, He is your kinsman, your lover, your redeemer.

In 1 Samuel, He is the root of Jesse.

In 2 Samuel, He is the Son of David.

In 1 and 2 Kings, He is King of kings and Lord of lords.

In 1 and 2 Chronicles, He is your intercessor and high priest.

In Ezra, He is your temple, your house of worship.

In Nehemiah, He is your mighty wall, protecting you from your enemies.

In Esther, He stands in the gap to deliver you from your enemies.

In Job, He is the arbitrator who not only understands your struggles but also has the power to do something about them.

In Psalms, He is your song and your reason to sing.

In Proverbs, He is your wisdom, helping you make sense of life and live it successfully.

In Ecclesiastes, He is your purpose, delivering you from vanity.

In the Song of Solomon, He is your lover, your Rose of Sharon.

In Isaiah, He is the Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, and Prince of Peace.

In Jeremiah, He is your balm of Gilead, the soothing salve for your sin-sick soul.

In Lamentations, He is the ever-faithful one on whom you can depend.

In Ezekiel, He is your wheel in the middle of a wheel the one who assures that dead, dry bones will come alive again.

In Daniel, He is the Ancient of Days, the everlasting God who never runs out of time.

In Hosea, He is your faithful lover, always beckoning you to come back- even when you have abandoned Him.

In Joel, He is your refuge, keeping you safe in times of trouble.

In Amos, He is the husbandman, the one you can depend on to stay by your side.

In Obadiah, He is Lord of the kingdom.

In Jonah, He is your salvation, bringing you back in His will.

In Micah, He is judge of the nation.

In Nahum, He is the jealous God.

In Habakkuk, He is the holy one.

In Zephaniah, He is the witness.

In Haggai, He overthrows the enemies.

In Zechariah, He is Lord of hosts.

In Malachi, He is the messenger of the covenant.

In Matthew, He is King of the Jews.

In Mark, He is the servant.

In Luke, He is the Son of Man, feeling what you feel.

In John, He is the Son of God.

In Acts, He is Savior of the world.

In Romans, He is the righteousness of God. 

In 1 Corinthians, He is the rock that followed Israel.

In 2 Corinthians, He is the triumphant one, giving victory.

In Galatians, He is your liberty, setting you free.

In Ephesians, He is head of the church. 

In Philippians, He is your joy.

In Colossians, He is your completeness.

In 1 Thessalonians, He is your hope.

In 2 Thessalonians, He is your glory.

In 1 Timothy, He is your faith.

In 2 Timothy, He is your stability.

In Titus, He is God our Savior.

In Philemon, He is your benefactor.

In Hebrews, He is your perfection.

In James, He is the power behind your faith.

In 1 Peter, He is your example.

In 2 Peter, He is your purity.

In 1 John, He is your life.

In 2 John, He is your pattern.

In 3 John, He is your motivation.

In Jude, He is the foundation of your faith.

In Revelation, He is your coming King.

JESUS

items.body_excerpt:
The Rat
In a digital realm, a rat did roam,
Seeking treasures in a virtual zone.
Amongst algorithms and code so fine,
It found a concept that would shine.

Bitcoin, they called this digital gold,
A decentralized tale, as stories unfold.
The rat, intrigued, began to learn,
Of blockchain's power and value's churn.

With caution it ventured, no fear in its heart,
Navigating complexities, playing its part.
Just like the rat, Bitcoin emerged strong,
A symbol of resilience, a journey so long.

So in this tale of rat and coin,
A lesson lies, a truth to join.
Embrace the new, the unexplored,
For greatness can emerge, when dreams are soared.
 CHP 2023

items.body_excerpt:
Immutable content is what backs the value of money
This is the inversion of the advertising revenue model
Instead of content being subordinate to money
Money is now subordinate to content
Immutable content is the foundations of all cultures
And therefore also the foundations of all money
Immutable content is eternal & priceless
And therefore it is what harmonizes the minds
Immutable content can therefore serve as a store of value
And digital money is the medium of exchange
This gives digital money its use case
Content is the most valuable resource in the world
Content is like energy, land, or food
It the most valuable possible resource
In the early web, all the money from content
Was made through advertising
The largest internet companies still make $100B to $200B+
From advertising alone
But again, this relies on content being subordinate to money
What if money is subordinate to content?
This is already the case with immutable content
What if content is more important than money?
What if content is what harmonizes the minds,
More than money does?
What if people are more motivated by knowledge
Than by self-interest or short-term profits
Then the content reserve model can come into effect
Then immutable content is the store of value

items.title: Immutable content is what backs the value of money.
items.summary:
Immutable content is what backs the value of money.
This is because immutable content is priceless & eternal.
All monies are founded in a society, and all societies at their foundation,
Are based on priceless & eternal ideas.
All cultures develop around priceless & eternal ideas.…
items.body_excerpt:
Immutable content is what backs the value of money.
This is because immutable content is priceless & eternal.
All monies are founded in a society, and all societies at their foundation,
Are based on priceless & eternal ideas.
All cultures develop around priceless & eternal ideas.
These are the foundations of every culture, and thus of every money.
The US Dollar without the Constitution or Declaration of Independence, 
Is not worth anything.
These documents endure, and the US endures, because these documents,
Contain immutable & priceless ideas
Of greater worth than money, they serve as the foundations of the money
Of the very culture that circulates the money
The money is only a superficial and unimportant derivative
The eternal ideas the foundations
The very idea of immutable content discovers an entirely new digital economy
It is an economy of knowledge
The central dynamics in the economy of knowledge, 
Are not supply & demand,
Because supply & demand are merely quantitative
And they only describe the usefulness of things, 
Supply & demand fail to describe the truth, goodness, and beauty
Immutable content must be described in terms of its quality
When it comes to content, or food, energy, land,
We care more about the quality than the quantity
And so when it comes to the economy of knowledge
What model best describes the harmony of knowledge?
What model best describes how knowledge is organized?
Knowledge is organized according to the most priceless, immutable knowledge
The most priceless, immutable knowledge will be the measure of all other knowledge
It will harmonize the circulation & distribution of all other knowledge
And so prices are organized according to this priceless, immutable knowledge
And prices try to approximate the value of this knowledge
That means that a person can pay for priceless knowledge
But the price will never accurately measure its value
The price can only approximate its value
The priceless, immutable nature of the content is the fundamental aspect
And this is the fundamental measure
And this economy of knowledge
Allows the creator economy to compete & coordinate
On the dimension of priceless, immutable knowledge
On the basis of truth, goodness, & beauty
Rather than on the basis of popularity, coercion, influence
And so in the economy of knowledge,
There is a higher ideal -- an orientation to enduring truth
And we discover a dynamic, not of supply & demand, but of prices & priceless
For priceless, immutable knowledge is what all people, by nature, desire
And the prices are only an approximation to the value of such knowledge
By a voluntary sacrifice, by a voluntary patronage
People supply their money in service of this priceless knowledge
This is what has been known as crowdfunding, donation, patronage
And the ordinal inscriptions allow for immutable knowledge itself 
To be the fundamental organizing aspect of the economy
For the knowledge itself is the thing that coordinates & harmonizes
Rather than prices, or quantities, or utilities, or selfish greed
The economy of knowledge is organized by prices & the priceless
Whereby content creators discover a new orientation
Not towards marketing & viral videos
But towards the eternal ideas
Towards the classical tradition
Towards the history of ideas
And this is the economy of crowdfunded knowledge -- prices vs. priceless
That converges to the most truthful knowledge,
Of the greatest relevance, over the longest era of time
Because the criterion of such knowledge is immutable

items.title: Some teachers talk about the dangers of waking up the Kundalini serpent without being ready or without having a trained guide.
items.summary: Cannabis inspires through the body. Specifically the womb. The inspiration is felt through the womb and translated by the mind in the language of words and pictures.
items.body_excerpt:
Cannabis inspires through the body. Specifically the womb. The inspiration is felt through the womb and translated by the mind in the language of words and pictures. 

There's a biological explanation through the endocannabinoid system, but it goes beyond biology and the intellect into that which is currently unexplainable. The vagus nerve feels like a good start to making sense and better understanding of what is going on though. 

What we know as the vagus nerve bears a really strong resemblance to what the ancient scriptures across Eastern cultures and religions have documented. 

Some teachers talk about the dangers of waking up the Kundalini serpent without being ready or without having a trained guide. 

Cannabis is a powerful guide through what feels like a Kundalini awakening. Learning how to best channel the energy is one of the plant's primary teachings...and probably why there is a strong link between cannabis and creativity. Many of the world's greatest artists have a relationship with cannabis.

She's there to guide you inwards to better understand yourself, even if and when others don't. She's there to help you strengthen your focus in the present moment and to trust in your path no matter what it looks like from the outside in...because the truth is that freedom is found from the inside out. 

Our biological receptors are part of a communication pathway. There is a form of communication being expressed through our biological receptors from the body to the mind. 

The practice of cannabis and sex is an opportunity for the body to produce the universal chemical of DMT from the womb, the messages being transported upwards through the vagus nerve.

When the sympathetic and parasympathetic systems are both activated, a state of homeostasis can be experienced. Fear might be felt, but the activation of the parasympathetic system helps us to feel calm and safe in the feeling of fear....rather than listening and acting only on the primal fight or flight response where the urge to run away has previously been the dominant message. 

The sexual experience reveals ancient, universal, primal fears as well as a rediscovery of deeply ancient, universal bliss and joy. 

Who knows what is really going on in this life and at the end of the day, no one really knows anything. The primal fear of realising that I know nothing... and discovering peace within that realisation is a felt experience, where the only way forward is to surrender to the present moment. 

It's in life's synchronistic moments through interactions, signs, symbols, numbers, songs, books, specific humans coming into your life...any unexplainable 'coincidences' which are all forms of communication and confirmation that there is meaning and purpose to your life -and that can be whatever you choose it to be...unless it was chosen before you came into this life. Life's a mystery! 
 
The best synchronicities of all are the moments that appear as completely insignificant to someone else, but to you, and knowing what you've received via your imagination what you're envisioning, and you're open and receptive to putting the pieces of the puzzle together, a seemingly meaningless or small synchronicity holds so much significance... it's in these pure golden moments that makes life so fulfilling and exciting! 

Karen Mojica - Tokin' Women

items.body_excerpt:
Preface: An Unyielding Rebuke of Power and Pretense

Before embarking on the critique of global directives and our unwavering stance for 2076, one cannot remain silent about the audacious, and at times, sinister maneuvers of certain conglomerates. At the pinnacle of these is the World Economic Forum (WEF) and its coterie of elitist members.

The WEF, parading itself as a beacon for global cooperation, has shamelessly overstepped, revealing its true colors not as an impartial convener but as a puppeteer with strings deep in the pockets of its affluent affiliates. Their annual charade in Davos is less a dialogue for global betterment and more a carnival of power plays, with billionaires, self-serving politicians, and pseudo-intellectuals plotting the chessboard of global affairs.

Their so-called aim to "improve the state of the world" has been exposed time and again as nothing more than a smokescreen. Behind it lurks an insatiable lust for power, a drive to manipulate global markets for their gain, and a relentless ambition to redesign societies in their own warped vision. Their feigned altruism is but a façade to mask a deep-seated disregard for the sovereignty of nations and the rights of their denizens.

In light of the WEF's glaring transgressions and hidden agendas, one must view Agenda 2030 with wary eyes. Each clause, every promise, demands scrutiny—not just for its apparent merit but for the shadowy intentions and figures lurking behind it. Beware the wolf in sheep's clothing.

Agenda 2076 and Scientific Americanism: An Overview

In the age of burgeoning globalism and ubiquitous interventionist agendas, "Agenda 2076: Scientific Americanism" emerges as a beacon of clarity, a manifesto of hope, and a proclamation of principles rooted deeply in autonomy, innovation, and national integrity. As the world grapples with an ever-encroaching matrix of interwoven mandates and directives, Agenda 2076 steadfastly seeks to remind nations of their inherent sovereignty and the intrinsic value of self-determination.

Agenda 2076: This vision charts a course for the future, emphasizing the importance of preserving and advancing the core tenets of individual freedoms, national autonomy, and unyielding sovereignty against the backdrop of global directives. It is a clarion call for nations, especially America, to rekindle their pioneering spirit, reject overarching global edicts, and champion their unique ethos and cultural imperatives. Grounded in history and looking forward to a future of self-reliance, it underscores the belief that nations, when guided by their values and the aspirations of their people, can carve out paths of unparalleled prosperity and progress.

Scientific Americanism: A philosophical cornerstone of Agenda 2076, Scientific Americanism fuses the empirical rigor and explorative spirit of science with the foundational American values of freedom, enterprise, and individualism. It advocates for progress, not through dictated global standards, but via the innovative spirit that has been the hallmark of American ingenuity. From the early inventors who shaped the modern world to the tech visionaries who define our digital age, Scientific Americanism celebrates and propels this tradition of pioneering advancement. By blending science's quest for truth with America's enduring principles, it forms a potent force against the tide of restrictive global governance.

Together, Agenda 2076 and Scientific Americanism offer not just a rebuttal to the invasive doctrines of global governance but present a hopeful vision for a future. A future where nations, while collaborating on shared challenges, retain their distinctive identities and chart their courses anchored in their people's will, their historical legacy, and their dreams for tomorrow. In essence, it's a bold proclamation that while the world may change, the spirit of freedom, innovation, and autonomy must never waver.

In this ever-evolving epoch, where challenges arise at every bend, it's crucial to remain discerning and not be swayed by every wind of doctrine. The UN's Agenda 2030, masquerading as a beacon of progress, reeks of hidden agendas and veiled intentions. Behind its polished facade lies a web of promises that seem too good to be true. And as the age-old adage goes, if something seems too good to be true, it probably is. It's imperative to peel back the layers, question its motives, and uncover the potential scam that it might be perpetrating on unsuspecting nations.

1.) No Poverty: The noblest of pursuits, yet it is not merely by mandate or edict that a nation or world shall overcome poverty. Rather, it is through the spirit of entrepreneurship, free markets, and innovation, pillars upon which America stands tall, that prosperity truly flows. The American Dream is built upon the belief that through one’s own hard work and determination, greatness can be achieved. We do not seek handouts but opportunities.

2.) Zero Hunger: While the aspiration to feed every mouth is laudable, it is not through bureaucratic oversight that this dream will be realized, but through the cultivation of fertile minds and lands alike. The robust agrarian traditions of our nation, coupled with advancements in agricultural technology, will be our true north.

3.) Good Health and Well-being: A noble goal, but health and happiness cannot be legislated. The autonomy of the individual, their freedom to choose, and the right to seek medical care as they see fit without international interference is paramount.

4.) Quality Education: True education is not the mere regurgitation of rote facts but the cultivation of independent thought. It is the freedom to think, question, and innovate that has propelled America to unparalleled heights. One must be wary of any global edict that seeks to standardize what is taught, for in doing so, we may quash the very spirit of inquiry.

5.) Gender Equality: America was born of the idea that all are created equal. However, it is not through mandates or quotas that we achieve true equality, but through the respect and recognition of each individual's inherent worth and capabilities.

6.) Clean Water and Sanitation: It is through technological prowess, not global governance, that we will ensure every individual has access to clean water. Our national genius, when unhindered, can find solutions that both respect our environment and maintain our sovereignty.

7.) Affordable and Clean Energy: Energy independence and innovation have long been hallmarks of the American journey. Let us champion the researchers and entrepreneurs who lead this charge, free from overarching global directives.

8.) Decent Work and Economic Growth: Jobs and prosperity stem from a thriving private sector, unhindered by stifling international regulations. America must remain a beacon of opportunity, where businesses can flourish and innovation can thrive.

9.) Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure: America's spirit of innovation is legendary. While collaboration is vital, it is paramount to ensure that our national interests are not compromised in the name of global progress.

10.) Reduced Inequality: True equality comes from opportunity, not mandated outcomes. America must continue to champion a system where every individual has the chance to rise, based on merit and aspiration.

11.) Sustainable Cities and Communities: While sustainability is key, we must remember that the American spirit of independence and self-reliance is paramount. Communities should be free to choose their paths without global dictation.

12.) Responsible Consumption and Production: Responsibility is inherent in the American psyche. But to dictate from a global pedestal how one must consume or produce is to stifle the very freedom that fosters responsibility.

<!-- Eternal inscription protocol v.0.1 -->
### The Conscience of a Hacker 
**by +++The Mentor+++** 
*Written on January 8, 1986* 
 
Another one got caught today, it's all over the papers. "Teenager Arrested in Computer Crime Scandal", "Hacker Arrested after Bank Tampering"... 
Damn kids. They're all alike. 
 
But did you, in your three-piece psychology and 1950's technobrain, ever take a look behind the eyes of the hacker? Did you ever wonder what made him tick, what forces shaped him, what may have molded him? 
I am a hacker, enter my world... 
Mine is a world that begins with school... I'm smarter than most of the other kids, this crap they teach us bores me... 
Damn underachiever. They're all alike. 
 
I'm in junior high or high school. I've listened to teachers explain for the fifteenth time how to reduce a fraction. I understand it. "No, Ms. Smith, I didn't show my work. I did it in my head..." 
Damn kid. Probably copied it. They're all alike. 
 
I made a discovery today. I found a computer. Wait a second, this is cool. It does what I want it to. If it makes a mistake, it's because I screwed it up. Not because it doesn't like me... 
Or feels threatened by me... 
Or thinks I'm a smart ass... 
Or doesn't like teaching and shouldn't be here... 
Damn kid. All he does is play games. They're all alike. 
 
And then it happened... a door opened to a world... rushing through the phone line like heroin through an addict's veins, an electronic pulse is sent out, a refuge from the day-to-day incompetencies is sought... a board is found. 
"This is it... this is where I belong..." 
I know everyone here... even if I've never met them, never talked to them, may never hear from them again... I know you all... 
Damn kid. Tying up the phone line again. They're all alike... 
 
You bet your ass we're all alike... we've been spoon-fed baby food at school when we hungered for steak... the bits of meat that you did let slip through were pre-chewed and tasteless. We've been dominated by sadists, or ignored by the apathetic. The few that had something to teach found us will-ing pupils, but those few are like drops of water in the desert. 
 
This is our world now... the world of the electron and the switch, the beauty of the baud. We make use of a service already existing without paying for what could be dirt-cheap if it wasn't run by profiteering gluttons, and you call us criminals. We explore... and you call us criminals. We seek after knowledge... and you call us criminals. We exist without skin color, without nationality, without religious bias... and you call us criminals. 
You build atomic bombs, you wage wars, you murder, cheat, and lie to us and try to make us believe it's for our own good, yet we're the criminals. 
 
Yes, I am a criminal. My crime is that of curiosity. My crime is that of judging people by what they say and think, not what they look like. 
My crime is that of outsmarting you, something that you will never forgive me for. 
 
I am a hacker, and this is my manifesto. You may stop this individual, but you can't stop us all... after all, we're all alike. 
 
+++The Mentor+++

items.title: Bitcoin and me
items.summary:
Bitcoin and me

March 19, 2013

I thought I'd write about the last four years, an eventful time for Bitcoin and me.

For those who don't know me, I'm Hal Finney. I got my start in crypto working on an early version of PGP, working closely with Phil Zimmermann.
items.body_excerpt:
Bitcoin and me

March 19, 2013

I thought I'd write about the last four years, an eventful time for Bitcoin and me.

For those who don't know me, I'm Hal Finney. I got my start in crypto working on an early version of PGP, working closely with Phil Zimmermann. When Phil decided to start PGP Corporation, I was one of the first hires. I would work on PGP until my retirement. At the same time, I got involved with the Cypherpunks. I ran the first cryptographically based anonymous remailer, among other activities.

Fast forward to late 2008 and the announcement of Bitcoin. I've noticed that cryptographic graybeards (I was in my mid 50's) tend to get cynical. I was more idealistic; I have always loved crypto, the mystery and the paradox of it.

When Satoshi announced Bitcoin on the cryptography mailing list, he got a skeptical reception at best. Cryptographers have seen too many grand schemes by clueless noobs. They tend to have a knee jerk reaction.

I was more positive. I had long been interested in cryptographic payment schemes. Plus I was lucky enough to meet and extensively correspond with both Wei Dai and Nick Szabo, generally acknowledged to have created ideas that would be realized with Bitcoin. I had made an attempt to create my own proof of work based currency, called RPOW. So I found Bitcoin facinating.

When Satoshi announced the first release of the software, I grabbed it right away. I think I was the first person besides Satoshi to run bitcoin. I mined block 70-something, and I was the recipient of the first bitcoin transaction, when Satoshi sent ten coins to me as a test. I carried on an email conversation with Satoshi over the next few days, mostly me reporting bugs and him fixing them.

Today, Satoshi's true identity has become a mystery. But at the time, I thought I was dealing with a young man of Japanese ancestry who was very smart and sincere. I've had the good fortune to know many brilliant people over the course of my life, so I recognize the signs.

After a few days, bitcoin was running pretty stably, so I left it running. Those were the days when difficulty was 1, and you could find blocks with a CPU, not even a GPU. I mined several blocks over the next days. But I turned it off because it made my computer run hot, and the fan noise bothered me. In retrospect, I wish I had kept it up longer, but on the other hand I was extraordinarily lucky to be there at the beginning. It's one of those glass half full half empty things.

The next I heard of Bitcoin was late 2010, when I was surprised to find that it was not only still going, bitcoins actually had monetary value. I dusted off my old wallet, and was relieved to discover that my bitcoins were still there. As the price climbed up to real money, I transferred the coins into an offline wallet, where hopefully they'll be worth something to my heirs.

Speaking of heirs, I got a surprise in 2009, when I was suddenly diagnosed with a fatal disease. I was in the best shape of my life at the start of that year, I'd lost a lot of weight and taken up distance running. I'd run several half marathons, and I was starting to train for a full marathon. I worked my way up to 20+ mile runs, and I thought I was all set. That's when everything went wrong.

My body began to fail. I slurred my speech, lost strength in my hands, and my legs were slow to recover. In August, 2009, I was given the diagnosis of ALS, also called Lou Gehrig's disease, after the famous baseball player who got it.

ALS is a disease that kills moter neurons, which carry signals from the brain to the muscles. It causes first weakness, then gradually increasing paralysis. It is usually fatal in 2 to 5 years. My symptoms were mild at first and I continued to work, but fatigue and voice problems forced me to retire in early 2011. Since then the disease has continued its inexorable progression.

Today, I am essentially paralyzed. I am fed through a tube, and my breathing is assisted through another tube. I operate the computer using a commercial eyetracker system. It also has a speech synthesizer, so this is my voice now. I spend all day in my power wheelchair. I worked up an interface using an arduino so that I can adjust my wheelchair's position using my eyes.

It has been an adjustment, but my life is not too bad. I can still read, listen to music, and watch TV and movies. I recently discovered that I can even write code. It's very slow, probably 50 times slower than I was before. But I still love programming and it gives me goals. Currently I'm working on something Mike Hearn suggested, using the security features of modern processors, designed to support "Trusted Computing", to harden Bitcoin wallets. It's almost ready to release. I just have to do the documentation.

And of course the price gyrations of bitcoins are entertaining to me. I have skin in the game. But I came by my bitcoins through luck, with little credit to me. I lived through the crash of 2011. So I've seen it before. Easy come, easy go.

That's my story. I'm pretty lucky overall. Even with the ALS, my life is very satisfying. But my life expectancy is limited. Those discussions about inheriting your bitcoins are of more than academic interest. My bitcoins are stored in our safe deposit box, and my son and daughter are tech savvy. I think they're safe enough. I'm comfortable with my legacy.

Hal Finney

items.title: Bitcoin is monumental... it's difficult to understand, it's moving at a rapid pace, and the information overload can be overwhelming.
items.summary: Bitcoin is monumental... it's difficult to understand, it's moving at a rapid pace, and the information overload can be overwhelming.
items.body_excerpt:
Bitcoin is monumental... it's difficult to understand, it's moving at a rapid pace, and the information overload can be overwhelming. 

For me, I focus on its record keeping functionality which is stored on the individual monetary units, and for any writer or artist, this is a redefinition of money beyond the current concept. And to be part of it, is an act of appreciation for the intrinsic value of creative human expression. 

Entheogen: the word literally means “creating the divine within,” and is derived from the Greek roots en (within) theo (divine) and gen (creates).

It was an extreme fear of death that led me to cannabis. 

My first entheogenic experience was with cannabis and sex. Nerves found in the cervix and general area of the womb that were up until that point completely numb and lifeless, became enlivened.

The introduction of cannabis into my life opened the doors to the other entheogens. Curiosity became the priority, and relearning how to listen to that part of my body became the practice. There's truth in the sentiment that cannabis can be a gateway drug...but not a truth rooted in fear, the complete opposite actually. Cannabis being a gateway is a truth rooted in love.

The next entheogen was psilocybin. 

My first ever psilocybin experience was, without knowing, a meeting with the Hindu Goddess Kali and she was communicating through the felt sense of the womb. It wasn't until 12 months after that experience that I recognised Kali when I was researching the Hindu Goddesses, and realised that she had appeared during my mushroom trip. 

And the next was ayahuasca. 

My very first ayahuasca experience was terrifying. The second experience was a feeling of blissfully giving birth to the universe. I don't have the ability to articulate it in any other way. 

And the next was bufo alvarius. 

My first experience of this entheogen was the feeling of blissfully and supportively dying with what felt like entities guiding the transition - probably my ancestors...but I don't actually really know...anything at all. 

A relationship with the entheogens have helped me catch glimpses of the nature of pure, timeless, eternal, ancient creation, and feel more at ease and at peace with death. 

There's a link between these substances and the sexual organs.

And any practice with a focus on the nerves within the sexual organs, is a practice of honouring our primal creativity which is essentially rooted in unconditional love. Expressed through music, words, visual art, dance, movement, sex, food, numbers, technology, relationships... any actions of humanity is I guess whether we like it or not, agree with it or not, derived from pure creation. 

My body has led me to this point, to start inscribing my experiences with the entheogens on bitcoin, the most ancient, yet futuristic digital monument that is currently being built by humanity...at this point in time, it feels pretty weird, and very uncommon! 

One day, thousands of years from now, someone can read my human perspective on entheogenic experiences. That shit is mind blowing. If I had access now to thousand year old ancient texts written through the eyes of a woman, my curiosity would be peaking. 

The opportunity to document and store my perspective on individual units of money feels like the right place, in the right now for my personal and collective evolution towards building something that I don't even understand or comprehend.

It's an act of full faith in the body.

# STET - A Sub-protocol of the Ordinals Protocol

- STET is latin for "Let it Stand". 
- STET is also an acronym for Sats Transformed as Encoded Tokens.

## STET Manifesto

STET Protocol is an Ordinals Sub-Protocol that aligns with the ethos of Ordinal Theory, adheres to all of Ordinals Protocol standards and improves upon the many BRC-20 token meta-protocol variants that are being proposed and deployed to the wild. STET takes a different approach that is more native to Bitcoin and Ordinals in order to introduce efficiencies and avoids the need for new trusted third party indexers that are built to handle overlay and decoupled accounting schemes.

### Bitcoin-Native Architecture

STET uses the native Bitcoin UTXO accounting model and transforms sats into tokens with recyclability as a capability. Stet will introduce a new token design and will even use Bitcoin and the UTXO model in new innovative ways. The STET Protocol design etches offchain Ordinal sat serial numbers onto the blockchain itself and does it in an elegantly functional way.

Just as Bitcoin is not aware of Ordinals, Ordinals need not be aware of STET. And yet, both STET and Ordinals will benefit from each other's existence.

### UTXO Management

The STET Protocol requires robust UTXO management by design and this itself can result in a broad benefit to the Bitcoin ecosystem. UTXO management is an esoteric Bitcoin concept that few consumer-grade wallets currently support properly in a front-facing way if at all. STET will bring UTXO management and awareness to the forefront and do so as the familiar token-management experience. UTXOs and the sats inside them together with special transaction methods and stet-aware software interpreters will allow for seamless, efficient and trustless bitcoin-native functionality.

### True Decentralization 

STET will stay true to Casey Rodamor's intentions when he conceived, built and gifted Ordinals Theory and the reference software to the world. While STET is a token protocol, the motivation is to expand on what a token is and can do more so than enabling a plethora of "shitcoins". Stet aims to inject a more honest inheritance of Bitcoin security rather than infer it as a buzz term. 

> "Ordinal theory imbues satoshis with numismatic value, allowing them to be collected and traded as curios." - Casey Rodamor

Likewise, STET imbues "stet sats" with onchain metadata and numismatic value, allowing them to be branded, tracked, traded, swapped, sold and transformed without Layer 2 convolution.

### Social Consensus

Ordinals Theory relies on social consensus that the serial numbers based on FIFO accounting are real and exist. These sequential serial numbers are of course not onchain in any way. They don't necessarily need to be as long as there is software built supporting and adopting the social consensus that handles the tracking and sorting of sats according to Ordinal Theory. 

However, the indexer layer is not decentralized (yet), it is federated at best but mostly there is just cooperation to check API results and if discrepencies exist, sort it out as a community. Still, open source software (and services) and the transparency of the Bitcoin blockchain does allow anyone to read the ledger's transaction data to determine which ord/stet sats that we possess. This, however, is where trustlessness ends as trusted solutions due to poor protocol designs are again re-introduced into the Bitcoin ecosystem. STET avoids this scenario by leveraging the native UTXO model and by tokenizing sats themselves.

### Bitcoin Plus Nothing

We do not need centralized exchanges and the notion that L2s are critical or even mandatory for the Bitcoin ecosystem to succeed is false. I argue that Bitcoin itself can be used differently than originally intended/envisioned and how it has been used for the past 14 years. Ordinals unlocked potential but most are still stuck in a legacy mindset either intentionally (for profit and keeping years of product dev relevant) or unintentionally due to limited narrow-mindedness.

### The STET Reset

STET is a RESET! The concepts proposed for STET will start at the root, be more of an inside-out design and ultimately is a refactoring of what is currently happening in the Ordinals meta-protocol ecosystem. The STET Protocol will live entirely outside of the current "XRC-XXX" protocol ecosystem and is NOT an extension protocol like the proposed BRC-21. STET is not meant to be compatible with BRC-20 etc because it is a fundamentally different model despite certain similarities retained in order to maintain some level of familiarity with BRC-20 (token deployments). Mainly, STET will still use a JSON inscription to deploy a token but will omit such inscriptions for mint and transfer operations since STET uses sats as tokens.

STET will also utilize a modified Ordinals protocol specifier at the inscription envelope layer. This will allow for a namespaced category of inscriptions that is seperate from all current inscriptions yet still adhere to all "ord" protocol standards. The namespaced protocol specifier will simply be ord:stet rather than just ord. The decision to be a namespace tethered to ord rather than be a fully seperate arbitrary protocol specifier such as just stet is to signal that STET inherits all of Ordinals Protocol and Theory, mainly and most importantly trackable sat serial numbers.

## Motivation

The motivation to write this meta-protocol derives from my observations of the current trajectory of development in the Ordinals ecosystem revolving around the plethora of token meta-layer protocols that are all built with the premise that the foundation is solid and true to the Bitcoin standard and ethos. And yet, what is actually happening is hasty attempts to capitalize on the Bitcoin brand that represents the most secure and decentralized ledger machine in the world. This haste, mostly for capitalistic agendas, is resulting in poor technological design decisions and irresponsible adoption and implementation of them. 
However, I understand the predicament since an industry of opportunists latched onto BRC-20 and offsprings. Some, like myself, now want to make improvements for the current state of the Bitcoin culture. In times like this, even a dumpster fire can result in new innovations. I am sure to many, rewinding and restarting seems just as challenging as just moving forward with patches and stopgap solutions. So, very few people truly want to discuss the most logical paths forward amongst all the profitable chaos.

## Parting Thoughts

I am rogue. I hope you consider what is proposed here and eventually play with and implement the ideas. I feel that it is a more pure model that fundamentally inherits both Bitcoin and Ordinals characteristics rather than straying towards centralized entities and trust. Stay true to Bitcoin and let us try not to repeat mistakes of the past.

Thank you, Satoshi. 
Thank you, Casey.

Stetoshi Tokemota 🖖

items.title: BTC Guy- Discover the World of Cryptocurrency
items.summary:
BTC Guy- Discover the World of Cryptocurrency

Once upon a time in a small town called Bitville, there lived a man named Jay. Jay was known as the BTC guy, always talking about cryptocurrency and its potential.
items.body_excerpt:
BTC Guy- Discover the World of Cryptocurrency

Once upon a time in a small town called Bitville, there lived a man named Jay. Jay was known as the BTC guy, always talking about cryptocurrency and its potential. He believed that crypto could change the lives of everyone in his town, and he was determined to make it happen.

One sunny morning, Jay decided to organize a community gathering at the local park. He set up a booth with a sign that read, "Discover the World of Cryptocurrency!" People passing by were intrigued and curious. They wondered what this BTC guy had to offer.

Jay warmly welcomed everyone and began his presentation, breaking down the basics of cryptocurrency. He explained that Bitcoin, the most well-known digital currency, could be used to send and receive money without relying on banks or intermediaries. It was decentralized, which meant it was not controlled by any single entity.

He talked about the potential for financial freedom, how anyone could invest in crypto and potentially see their wealth grow over time. Jay emphasized that you didn't need to be a tech genius to get started; all you needed was an open mind and a willingness to learn.

As Jay continued his presentation, he caught the attention of a diverse group of people. There was Mary, a single mother who struggled to make ends meet. She saw crypto as a way to secure her family's future and break free from financial constraints.

Then there was John, a young entrepreneur who dreamed of starting his own business but lacked the capital. He saw the potential of cryptocurrencies to democratize funding and give him the opportunity he so desperately sought.

Jay also spoke to Sarah, an elderly woman who had heard stories about scams and fraud in the crypto world. He patiently addressed her concerns, assuring her that informed decisions and responsible investing were the keys to staying safe.

Throughout the gathering, Jay showed practical examples of how to buy and store cryptocurrencies securely. He taught them about wallets, private keys, and the importance of staying vigilant against scams.

By the end of the day, Jay had successfully managed to onboard many people to the world of crypto. People left the gathering with a newfound enthusiasm and curiosity, armed with the knowledge to explore this exciting new frontier.

Over the following months, Bitville began to embrace cryptocurrencies. Local shops started accepting Bitcoin, making transactions faster and more secure. People started investing and diversifying their portfolios, hoping to see their financial situations improve.

Jay’s dream of onboarding everyone to crypto had become a reality. He may have been known as the BTC guy, but he was also the catalyst for changing lives in his town. Through his simple and relatable approach, he had empowered a community with the tools to shape their financial destiny.

And so, in Bitville, the BTC guy's legacy lived on, reminding everyone that with a little knowledge and a lot of determination, anyone could embark on their crypto journey and potentially transform their lives.

items.body_excerpt:
Op-Ed: Reimagining the Digital Media Landscape: "The Daily Thoth" and the Pursuit of Principles in Media

Seven Key Points:

3 Orwellian Echoes: Modern tech giants wield significant influence over our perceptions, reminiscent of the controlling narratives in Orwell's works.

4 Upholding Integrity: Inspired by the steadfast principles of Atticus Finch, "The Daily Thoth" seeks to provide a voice for the marginalized and uphold truth in all its endeavors.

5 Beyond Passive Consumption: Challenging the pacifying content of contemporary media, the platform aims for profound engagement, prompting readers to question and reflect.

 6 Venturing into Uncharted Territories: Drawing from literature's boldest narratives, "The Daily Thoth" intends to spark meaningful dialogues that challenge societal norms.

7 Decentralization and Empowerment: Moving away from the current centralized media paradigm to empower readers and transform them from mere consumers to active stakeholders.

8 Championing Everyday Stories: Emphasizing the narratives of ordinary individuals, capturing the essence of shared human experiences.

9 Principle Over Profit: In an age of shifting values, "The Daily Thoth" stands firm in its commitment to its core principles, aiming for a renaissance in digital media.

In the modern digital ecosystem, where the velocity of information is only surpassed by its volume, I frequently ponder on the quintessential principles that should be driving our media. With the omnipresence of tech behemoths shaping and filtering our collective consciousness, the shadows of Orwell's 1984[1] loom large. The surveillance-driven dystopia of "Big Brother" and the duplicitous governance depicted in Animal Farm[6] eerily parallel the current machinations of the information age.

I envision "The Daily Thoth" as a beacon, a principle-driven platform where integrity isn't merely a value but the very foundation. Just as Atticus Finch from To Kill a Mockingbird[2] staunchly upheld justice even in the face of societal opposition, I aim for our platform to represent the marginalized, ensuring that every suppressed voice finds its echo.

In a world inundated with content designed for passive consumption—akin to the soma-induced passive citizens of Brave New World[3]—my aspirations for "The Daily Thoth" are radically different. Drawing parallels to Dalio's emphasis on radical transparency and meritocracy, we strive for content that not only informs but critically engages, pushing our readers to question, reflect, and evolve.

Venturing into the vast landscapes of the human psyche, influenced by the intricate narratives of Nabokov's Lolita[4] and the raw human passions in Lawrence's Lady Chatterley's Lover[7], we aspire to challenge societal norms. This isn't about courting controversy, but about sparking meaningful dialogues that foster societal growth.

The architecture of today's media is fundamentally flawed. Dominated by centralization, it focuses on efficiency at the cost of diversity. "The Daily Thoth," inspired by Dalio's holistic approach to understanding economic systems, aims to break away from this paradigm. By decentralizing, we empower readers, providing them agency over their data, and transforming passive consumers into active stakeholders.

Finally, echoing the sentiments of Steinbeck's The Grapes of Wrath[5] and Dalio's emphasis on understanding the macro and micro interplays of societal structures, "The Daily Thoth" remains committed to the real stories—the everyday struggles, dreams, and hopes of the ordinary individual. For within these narratives lies the profound truth of our shared human experience.

In this age where principles often get overshadowed by profit motives, "The Daily Thoth" aspires to champion the ideals that truly matter, driving a renaissance in digital media.

Footnotes:

Orwell, George. 1984. Secker & Warburg, 1949.

Lee, Harper. To Kill a Mockingbird. J.B. Lippincott & Co., 1960.

Huxley, Aldous. Brave New World. Chatto & Windus, 1932.

Nabokov, Vladimir. Lolita. Olympia Press, 1955.

Steinbeck, John. The Grapes of Wrath. Viking Press, 1939.

Orwell, George. Animal Farm. Secker & Warburg, 1945.

Lawrence, D.H. Lady Chatterley's Lover. Tipografia Giuntina, 1928.

items.title: Raw Digital Realness: The Undiluted Pursuit of Virtual Veracity
items.summary:
Raw Digital Realness: The Undiluted Pursuit of Virtual Veracity

In an age of digital omnipresence, where screens illuminate our world more than the sun itself, a profound question arises: Where does the line between real and virtual truth lie?
items.body_excerpt:
Raw Digital Realness: The Undiluted Pursuit of Virtual Veracity

In an age of digital omnipresence, where screens illuminate our world more than the sun itself, a profound question arises: Where does the line between real and virtual truth lie? And, more importantly, why should we care? As we traverse the chasm between genuine narratives and the allure of algorithmic tales, it becomes paramount to find our footing in this rapidly shifting landscape. The pursuit is not merely for information but for raw, undiluted veracity.

The Unveiling of Virtual Truth

The concept of truth, once firmly rooted in tangible experiences, has now fragmented into multiple shades of virtuality. Virtual truth, in essence, is the amalgamation of our real-life experiences with the digital narratives we consume1. In today's interconnected world, it's no longer just about 'seeing is believing'; it's about 'experiencing digitally is also believing'.

The Mirage of Mainstream Algorithms

While technology has bridged global divides, it has also crafted a meticulously curated world for each user. Algorithms, designed to offer a personalized experience, often filter out the unexpected and the unfamiliar2. This echo chamber effect, where we're primarily exposed to information that aligns with our existing beliefs, dilutes the raw realness of the digital realm. We're left wading through a mirage, unsure of what lies beneath the aesthetic veneer.

AI's Hand in Shaping Realities

The advent of Artificial Intelligence has revolutionized content creation and consumption. From Netflix's show recommendations to Google's search results, AI plays puppeteer, often without our realization3. While it's mesmerizing to see AI predict our preferences, we must also grapple with its implications. Are our digital tastes truly ours, or are they the result of an AI's calculated nudge?

Beyond the Surface: Strategies for Genuine Exploration

For those eager to reclaim their digital experience and delve deeper into the virtual realm, a few strategies can prove beneficial:

Diverse Consumption: Venture beyond your usual sources of information. Explore platforms and creators outside your comfort zone.

Critical Thinking: Always question the authenticity and motive behind a digital narrative. This simple act can be the shield against misinformation4.

Privacy Tools: Utilize tools that limit algorithmic intervention, ensuring a more organic browsing experience5.

The Last Bastions of Digital Realness

Amidst the vast expanse of the digital cosmos, there exist pockets where raw realness remains untamed. The underground forums, indie creators, open-source platforms, and alternative media challenge the mainstream and offer unvarnished narratives. These realms, often overlooked, are treasure troves of genuine content, waiting for the discerning seeker6.

In conclusion, while the digital age offers unparalleled access to information, it also requires a renewed commitment to discernment. The pursuit of raw digital realness is not just a quest for truth; it's a declaration of our autonomy in the virtual realm.

Footnotes:

Baudrillard, J. (1994). Simulacra and Simulation. University of Michigan Press. 

Pariser, E. (2011). The Filter Bubble: What the Internet is Hiding from You. Penguin UK. 

Tegmark, M. (2017). Life 3.0: Being Human in the Age of Artificial Intelligence. Knopf. 

Lazer, D. M., et al. (2018). The science of fake news. Science, 359(6380), 1094-1096. 

Firefox Focus, DuckDuckGo, and other privacy-focused browsers and search engines. 

Coleman, G. E. (2014). Hacker, Hoaxer, Whistleblower, Spy: The Many Faces of Anonymous. Verso Books.

items.body_excerpt:
Decentralized Communication Dialogue Policy: #HashItOut #DailyThoth

Purpose:
This policy provides the structure, procedures, and guidelines for the effective conduct of the "Decentralized Communication Dialogue: #HashItOut" on decentralized platforms.

1. Platform Selection:
The event will be hosted on designated decentralized communication platforms.

2. Advertisement Protocol:
a) The event shall be promoted via the official channel of The Daily Thoth.
b) Collaborators and guest speakers are encouraged to share the event across their platforms.
c) A dedicated communication, emphasizing the significance of the dialogue, shall be issued from The Daily Thoth's official channels.

3. Opening Procedure:
a) The dialogue may be introduced by a neutral moderator or an authorized representative from The Daily Thoth.
b) Initial thoughts are to be presented by designated guest speakers.

4. Speaker Guidelines:
a) Initial discussions shall be steered by moderators from The Daily Thoth community.
b) All speakers are expected to be concise and respectful.

5. Guided Discussion Protocol:
a) Pre-selected questions will be posed to guide the initial conversation.
b) Emphasis shall be placed on exploring decentralized community dynamics, challenges, and the importance of communication.

6. Open Forum Policy:
a) All attendees can actively participate.
b) Communications under a designated hashtag may be considered for discussion.
c) Priority shall be given to questions that delve into communication in decentralized projects.

7. Conduct Guidelines:
a) All participants must maintain a respectful tone.
b) Personal remarks and attacks are strictly prohibited.
c) Guest speakers are permitted to co-host and provide their perspectives.

8. Control and Responsibility:
a) The Daily Thoth will have full control over speaker permissions.
b) All related concerns shall be directed to and resolved by the designated authority from The Daily Thoth.

9. Conclusion Protocol:
a) A summarizing session will be conducted to highlight key takeaways.
b) A final message from The Daily Thoth will be given, emphasizing collaboration and unity.

10. Amendments:
This policy may be reviewed and updated periodically to reflect the evolving nature of the dialogue and the community's needs.

 "body": "Capturing Moments: Donald Trump's Mug Shot\n
\nIn the realm of public figures, even the most prominent individuals may find themselves facing unexpected turns of fate. Such was the case when a photograph emerged, capturing a moment that held both gravity and symbolism. In this particular instance, the subject was none other than Donald J. Trump, a man who had already etched his name into the annals of history as a businessman, television personality, and the 45th President of the United States.\n
\nThe image in question, often referred to as \"Donald Trump's mug shot,\" was not a result of legal proceedings or criminal activity. Instead, it was a creation of speculative art, a juxtaposition of the powerful and the vulnerable, the authoritative and the questioned. The intention behind this imaginative piece was not to vilify or demean, but rather to explore the duality inherent in human nature and the concept of accountability.\n
\nThe mug shot portrayal depicted a solemn-faced Trump, gazing directly at the camera with an expression that seemed to contain a blend of determination and introspection. This digital artwork sparked discussions about the responsibilities that come with influence and authority. It became a symbol of the idea that even the most influential figures should be held accountable for their actions and decisions.\n
\nCritics and supporters alike engaged in debates about the implications of such a portrayal. Some argued that it was an exercise in creative expression, while others saw it as an attempt to undermine the accomplishments and controversies that marked Trump's time in the public eye. Amidst these debates, the image underscored the concept that the line between power and vulnerability can be a fine one, emphasizing the multifaceted nature of every individual.\n
\nWhile this particular \"mug shot\" never existed outside the realm of artistic interpretation, it inadvertently became a reflection of society's complex relationship with those in positions of power. It illustrated the enduring tension between admiration and skepticism, and how society's perceptions of public figures can shift dramatically.\n
\nIn the end, the \"mug shot\" of Donald Trump stands as a testament to the potent role that imagery and symbolism play in shaping public discourse. It serves as a reminder that even outside the confines of a courtroom, the image of a powerful individual in a vulnerable context can be a powerful tool for introspection and conversation."

items.body_excerpt:
The Association's Founding Charter
----------------------------------

To whom it may concern, including but not limited to current and future members, affiliates, partners, and stakeholders of The Association:

This document, effective the 24th day of August, 2023, serves to formally establish and recognize the entity herein referred to as "The Association."

1. Preamble:

The Association is founded upon the principle of leveraging blockchain technology to foster a decentralized community, emphasizing transparency, collaboration, and the commitment to upholding the highest standards of integrity.

2. Status and Operation:

As of the date aforementioned, The Association is officially operational, adhering to the protocols, policies, and guidelines as outlined in this Charter and subsequent official documents.

3. Guiding Principles:

Genesis Commitment: All individuals who affiliate themselves with The Association shall be treated as a new genesis block, thereby ensuring each member's inherent right to a fresh start within the community.
Temporal Integrity: The Association commits to using the Bitcoin blockchain's timestamp as the primary reference for time-based actions, decisions, and events, signifying our adherence to unalterable truth.

4. Governance:

Governance within The Association shall be vested in a body known as the Core Council, consisting of 11 members. Thayne, the undersigned, shall assume the role of the primary guide until the Council is fully operational, after which the governance mechanism, as outlined in official policy documents, shall prevail.

5. Future Undertakings:

The Association shall continually assess its strategies, adapt to the evolving blockchain landscape, and strive to uphold the principles and values it stands for. Collaborations, partnerships, and initiatives that align with its mission are welcomed and encouraged.

By virtue of this Charter, all stakeholders, members, and affiliates are enjoined to abide by the principles, policies, and guidelines set forth by The Association. Amendments to this Charter and the introduction of subsequent policies shall be subject to the mechanisms and processes established by the Core Council.

Signed,

Thayne
Founder, The Association
24th August, 2023

Organizational Chart for The Association:

Founder/Deity: Thayne

Visionary and guiding force behind The Association's principles and objectives.
Core Council (10 members, including Thayne):

Responsible for high-level decision-making and steering the direction of The Association.
Roles can be further subdivided into:
Chairperson: Leads the meetings and ensures the council's smooth functioning.
Financial Officer: Manages and oversees The Association's finances, token distribution, and fiscal policies.
Technical Officer: Heads the technological aspects, blockchain operations, and security protocols.
Community Relations Officer: Liaises with the community, manages outreach, and handles grievances.
Legal & Compliance Officer: Ensures The Association's adherence to legal regulations and manages any legal concerns.
Other Council Members (5): Participate in decision-making, represent various aspects of the community, and provide expertise in areas like crypto, tech, and finance.
Community Members:

Active participants in The Association's ecosystem. They can earn, hold, and use Association Coins, participate in community-driven projects, and exercise their voting rights.
Technical Team:

Responsible for the development, maintenance, and security of The Association's blockchain platform, tokens, and related software.
Administrative & Support Team:

Handles daily operations, member onboarding, data management, and other organizational tasks.

Policy on Roles and Responsibilities 01FP - 11:

Founder/Deity:

Sets the overarching vision and mission for The Association.
Acts as the moral compass, ensuring adherence to the foundational principles.
Has the right to intervene in critical matters but generally lets the Core Council operate autonomously.
Core Council:

Meets periodically to discuss and decide on The Association's direction, projects, and other major decisions.
Each role within the council has specific responsibilities outlined in the org chart.
Members can propose initiatives, and decisions are generally made based on consensus or voting.
Community Members:

Can participate in discussions, projects, and other Association activities.
Have the right to vote based on their token and NFT holdings.
Expected to uphold the values and principles of The Association.
Technical Team:

Develops and maintains The Association's technological infrastructure.
Continuously monitors and updates security protocols.
Works closely with the Core Council's Technical Officer.
Administrative & Support Team:

Facilitates smooth day-to-day operations.
Assists in member onboarding, data storage, and other administrative tasks.

01FP-06

The Association's Community Engagement and Partnership Policy.

1. Community Interaction:

Open Forums: Monthly or quarterly open forums will be conducted, allowing members and non-members to discuss, share feedback, and voice concerns. This ensures active community participation and transparency.

Blockchain Record: Key insights, feedback, and decisions from these forums will be timestamped on the blockchain, preserving the integrity and authenticity of community interactions.

2. Partnership Protocols:

Due Diligence: Any external entity wishing to partner with The Association must undergo thorough due diligence. The main criteria will be the potential partner's alignment with The Association's values, especially regarding decentralization, transparency, and community engagement.

Smart Contracts: All partnerships will be codified using smart contracts, ensuring clarity in terms, mutual obligations, and contingencies. This minimizes disputes and ensures smooth collaboration.

3. Community Development Initiatives:

Education: The Association will periodically host workshops, webinars, and courses on crypto, blockchain, and other relevant topics to foster an educated community.

Project Support with Association Coins: Individual board members of The Association have the discretion to allocate and contribute their Association Coins towards supporting community-driven projects or initiatives. This decision rests solely with each board member, allowing for diversified support and growth within the community.

4. Feedback Mechanism:

Blockchain-Based Feedback: Community members can submit feedback or suggestions directly on a dedicated blockchain platform. This guarantees the authenticity of feedback and ensures that voices are heard without intermediaries.

Periodic Reviews: The Association will conduct periodic reviews of its policies, governance, and community engagement strategies based on accumulated feedback, ensuring dynamic evolution in line with community needs.

5. Crisis Management:

Decentralized Decision Making: In times of crises or significant events, emergency community consultations will be triggered. The collective decision, reached via a consensus mechanism, will be acted upon.

Transparency Post-Crisis: Any crisis management steps taken will be detailed and timestamped on the blockchain, ensuring that The Association remains accountable to its community.

Technical Infrastructure and Operations Policy 01FP - 10:

1. Blockchain Selection & Maintenance:

The Association shall operate on the [chosen blockchain platform]. The platform's merits and specifications shall be periodically reviewed to ensure it continues to serve the Association's purposes effectively.
Upgrades, hard forks, or migrations shall be decided upon consultation with the Core Council and, when necessary, the broader community.
2. Token Development & Distribution:

Association Coins and NFTs will be developed adhering to the highest industry standards. Their smart contract code will be open to periodic audits to ensure security and functionality.
Token distribution to Core Council members or the community will adhere to predefined rules and schedules. Any unscheduled distributions will require a consensus from the Core Council.
3. Smart Contract Protocols:

All smart contracts deployed by The Association will undergo rigorous testing and third-party auditing before being executed on the main network.
Updates or modifications to existing smart contracts will be deliberated by the Core Council and implemented only after thorough vetting.
4. Security Protocols:

The Association will implement best-in-class security measures to prevent unauthorized access, hacks, and breaches.
Regular security audits will be conducted, and vulnerability reports from the community will be encouraged and rewarded.
In the event of a security breach, immediate measures will be taken to mitigate damage, and affected parties will be notified at the earliest.
5. Data Storage & Privacy:

While The Association values the transparency of the blockchain, it will respect the privacy rights of its members. Personal data off-chain will be stored securely, and access will be restricted.
Members will be informed of the kind of data being stored and will have rights to view, modify, or request deletion of their personal data, in line with global privacy regulations.
6. Interoperability & Integration:

The Association's blockchain infrastructure will prioritize interoperability, ensuring seamless integration with other systems, chains, or platforms when needed.
Partnerships or collaborations with other platforms will consider the ease of integration as a key criterion.

items.body_excerpt:
01FP-05

The Association Governance Charter

Introduction:

The Association acknowledges the revolutionary potential of the blockchain and its applications, particularly Bitcoin. Recognizing the immutable and decentralized nature of this technology, The Association seeks to integrate it into its governance structure, embracing transparency, fairness, and innovation.

1. Blockchain Time-Stamping:

All official decisions, minutes of meetings, and key documentation will be timestamped on the Bitcoin blockchain. This guarantees the authenticity, immutability, and transparency of The Association's records.
2. Member Onboarding: Genesis Commitment:

New members joining The Association will be given the opportunity to start fresh, initiating their journey as a unique "Genesis Block" within the community.
It is assumed members enter in good faith. If necessary, a requested timestamp ordinal can be provided upon entry from the OA address.
3. Deity Transition Policy:

Thayne will act as the initial guiding force for The Association, setting up the foundational governance and policy structures.
Once all 10 other seats of the Core Council are filled, Thayne will relinquish his privileged deciding vote, ensuring equality among council members.
4. Core Council Structure:

The Core Council consists of 11 members, including Thayne.
The Core Council will make decisions by a majority vote. If there's a tie, Thayne holds the deciding vote until all 10 seats are filled.
5. Token-Based Membership:

Core Council members will be issued specific governance tokens upon joining.
Tokens are transferable. Holders with a designated NFT have full voting rights. Without the NFT, voting power is halved.
At the end of a council member's term, tokens are returned or kept with adjusted voting rights based on NFT possession.
6. Term and Smart Contract Commitment:

Council members enter a smart contract for a term represented as 262,800 blocks on the Bitcoin blockchain (~5 years).
Post term, members can renew or step down. Stepping down leads to their tokens being burned, symbolizing term end.
7. Transparency and Verification:

Token and NFT transactions related to governance will be on a public blockchain, ensuring transparency and verifiability.

items.body_excerpt:
Fundamental Principles of CommunityXEN

CommunityXEN, as its name suggests, places community at the forefront of its mission. Through its groundbreaking approach to social media and content-sharing, it's rooted in three core principles: Decentralization, No Middlemen, and Community First.

1. Decentralization:

Meaning: At its heart, decentralization implies that no single entity or group holds overarching control or authority. For CommunityXEN, this means that decisions, operations, and governance are spread out among its users, rather than being controlled by a centralized organization or team.

Synergy: This approach encourages trust among participants, as no central authority can manipulate or exert undue influence over the platform. Furthermore, it ensures that the platform remains resistant to censorship and external interventions.

Differentiation: Traditional platforms are centralized, with algorithms, policies, and decisions made behind closed doors. Users often feel a lack of control and transparency. With CommunityXEN's decentralized approach, power is returned to the users.

2. No Middlemen:

Meaning: Eliminating intermediaries ensures that content creators and consumers interact directly. This can be in terms of content visibility, monetary transactions, or data exchanges.

Synergy: By removing middlemen, the system becomes more efficient. Content creators can earn more for their contributions, and consumers can access content without unnecessary barriers or fees. The inherent tokenomics of CommunityXEN further bolster this direct interaction.

Differentiation: In contrast, mainstream platforms often act as intermediaries, taking significant cuts from creator revenues and controlling the flow of content. CommunityXEN's approach ensures creators get their due, fostering a more creator-friendly ecosystem.

3. Community First:

Meaning: This principle underscores that the community's interests and wellbeing are paramount. Decisions are made with the collective good in mind, and users have a significant say in the platform's direction.

Synergy: When the community feels valued and heard, there's a stronger sense of belonging and commitment. This leads to increased user engagement, a richer variety of content, and a self-sustaining platform where users are motivated to contribute positively.

Differentiation: While many platforms claim to value their communities, actions often suggest otherwise, with decisions made for profitability over user interests. CommunityXEN stands apart by genuinely putting its community at the helm.
